summaryInsights: Demand is occasion-led and item-specific, not category-led: reviews repeatedly cite birthdays, pre-orders and named requests (R5, R14, R19, R21), so a seasonal campaign hub plus reservation/pre-order visibility is the single highest-leverage site fix.

Character and IP franchises are the real navigation layer — Takara Tomy, Beyblade X, Bandai TCG, Pokémon cards and Sanrio dominate best-seller lists (B1-B8, C3, C4) — yet the site lacks IP hubs, pushing discovery to Amazon and Rakuten by default.
